hooks.name: Vertical slice reminder for schema changes
hooks.description: Requirement 16.1: when a Drizzle schema file is saved, remind the agent to generate the migration and finish the vertical slice.

action.prompt:
You changed the Drizzle schema in packages/db/src/schema. Per quality.md, a persistence change is done only when every layer ships together:
1. Generate the migration: `docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml run --rm -T toolbox bash -c 'cd packages/db && pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --name <change>'`. Review the SQL and commit it. Never use `push`.
2. Add a query module function in packages/db/src/queries with a Testcontainers test.
3. Add an operation with strict Zod input and an authorization check, register it in apps/web/src/server/operations/registry.ts, and add its case to the cross-user test.
4. Show the data in the UI with loading, empty, error, and success states in the design language.
5. Add an integration test against real Postgres and a Playwright end-to-end test through the UI.
No table or column may exist without a user-facing or operator-facing representation. Apply the migration locally with `make migrate`.
